show.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
show.headline: Daylight come and me wan’ our limited-time menu
show.description:
After 36 years in the grave, visionary Tim Burton has resurrected the infamous bio-exorcist for another delightfully morbid romp through the lands of the living and the dead. After an unexpected family tragedy, three generations of the Deetz family return to the house where it all began. Haunted by her family’s legacy (and probably a few other specters), Astrid’s (Jenna Ortega) life is turned upside down after accidentally unleashing the Ghost with the Most, Betelguese (Michael Keaton). Now, her mother, Lydia (Winona Ryder), and grandmother, Delia (Catherine O'Hara), will have to contend with the mischievous demon once again as he unleashes mayhem on the living world.

BEETLEJUICE BEETLEJUICE is just about everything you could want out of a sequel to Burton’s iconic original. Keaton is as wonderfully brash and devious as ever, while the ghastly camp of the afterlife brings the classic Burton vibes very much back to life. Seeing Ryder and O’Hara reprise their iconic roles is like falling right back in with an old friend, while newcomers to the land of the dead Jenna Ortega, Willem Dafoe, Justin Theroux, and Monica Bellucci bring their (mostly dead) characters to life beautifully.

image.altText: BEETLEJUICE BEETLEJUICE Limited-time Menu & Sandworm Popcorn Bucket

contentBlocks.paragraphs:
We’re as excited for Betelguese’s return as you are, so we figured we’d serve up a few of his favorite dishes (excluding cockroaches) on our limited-time BEETLEJUICE BEETLEJUICE menu. Join us at any show at participating theaters from 9/02 - 9/30 for our lemon pepper Beetlewings Beetlewings, a Sandwich for the Recently Deceased with beer-braised pork, Tally Me Banana Pudding, and a cold glass of The Juice Is Loose IPA (aka, Fresh Squeezed IPA from Deschutes Brewery). Available at participating theaters.

We’ll even have a limited-edition Sandworm popcorn bucket available to order at your seat at BEETLEJUICE BEETLEJUICE shows at participating theaters while supplies last. This exclusive collectible is pulled straight from the afterlife and perfect for holding popcorn or eating pesky specters. Ticket required for purchase. One popcorn bucket per guest. Sales begin opening day, while supplies last at participating theaters.
